admission.justification: The repository and dashboard ignore owners keep the two local environment kinds out of candidate inventories, and the product enumeration case checks that exclusion without asserting a live lifecycle run.

applicability: Ignored mcp/.venv and dashboard/node_modules directories contained in task code worktrees and their Git-based lifecycle candidate inventories.
conditions: The environment directories remain ignored and contained in the worktree.
Actual live sync, closeout and cleanup observations are recorded by their transaction owner; the accounting test proves enumeration, not a completed transaction.
exclusions: User caches, the shared interpreter and failed rollback candidates outside the worktree.
The node_modules half of the accounting test is structural when no Node environment is installed.
No lifecycle execution or cleanup PASS is inferred from a test/citation alone.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_worktree_own_environment.py::test_candidate_accounting_excludes_worktree_environments, green on live venv; freeze A3 journal 260928-MIK-L136-A3

statement: The ignored worktree environments stay out of sync, closeout and landing candidate accounting and are removed with the worktree at cleanup.
